summary: Implementation fully matches the saved plan. auth_mounts_claude.py adds the per-workspace overlay flock backstop: fcntl + Literal/Iterator imports, _OVERLAY_PROVISION_LOCK_NAME, the 3 module-private reason codes (DISCARD_LOCK_CONTENDED, DISCARD_SKIPPED_LIVE_MOUNT, PROVISION_LOCK_UNAVAILABLE), the _overlay_provision_lock context manager (LOCK_NB, yields acquired/contended/unavailable, catches only OSError/BlockingIOError, releases in finally), and the wrapper + _prepare_claude_overlay_mount_locked split that keeps supported()/reserved-char copy-fallback guards before any lock and serializes discard+mount. The discard is restructured into explicit observable branches preserving #416's double is_mounted check; contended reuses-or-defers without rmtree or off-lock mount; unavailable proceeds best-effort. New test part_007 covers serialized-discard, contended-live-reuse, acquire/release, uncontended-discard, and unavailable; part_004's race test asserts the new SKIPPED_LIVE code. Diff is scoped to exactly the planned files (no re-export/API changes), honoring all non-goals. Per-lock-state and discard branches are each exercised by tests (broad-guard skip via the pre-existing part_001 live-mount-reuse test).
